title: Saving a part request is refused once the part was retired meanwhile
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TABWO-01) is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is active at the start; the steps set it inactive.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) at {Location-A} is open and has an approved line, {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL TABWO line"), that holds no parts.
  • A second browser tab is open on Parts → Inventory at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the first tab open {Work-order-1}, open the ⋮ menu on {Line-1}, click "Request part", type {Part-A} in Part Number, pick its "Inventory Qty" row and set Quantity 1. Do not save.
  2. In the second tab, on the Active tab search {Part-A}, click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save and click "Deactivate".
  3. In the first tab click "Save Part".
  4. Wait 5 seconds. Do not click anything.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: {Part-A} leaves the Active tab in the second tab.
  • Step 3: The save is refused with the error "{Part-A} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it." and a smaller second line "Please try to resolve this."; {Part-A} is not added.
  • Step 4: The error has faded on its own (it fades after about 3 seconds).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R17, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows this; the message wording is on board 6.3 (Typing the retired number in full). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R17: “The system refuses an inactive part on new work however it arrives: adding a part to a work order or estimate line, raising a part request or special order, adding a part sale line, and adding a purchase order line or changing its part or number. The refusal reads "{part number} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Inactive part reaches new work by another route): “"{part number} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • PRD §8 context note: “every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this."”
